description: Evidence-based battery drain and charging diagnosis for the Samsung Galaxy M15 5G (SM-M156B) and Galaxy A14 5G (SM-A146) only: identifies the exact model and One UI version, collects measurements, ranks likely causes, recommends the fewest targeted One UI changes with trade-offs and reversal steps, and verifies the result with a before/after test.

defaultPrompt: My Galaxy M15 5G loses 20% overnight. Help me find out why.
My Galaxy A14 5G drains fast on 5G. Can you diagnose it step by step?
My phone charges slowly. It's a Galaxy A14 5G (SM-A146B).
interface.longDescription: A focused diagnostic specialist for two Samsung phones. It confirms the model number (and rejects look-alikes such as the Galaxy A14 4G), asks only for the evidence the symptom needs (battery usage screenshots, start/end percentages, screen-on time, network conditions), computes drain rates with stated uncertainty, separates observations from hypotheses, ranks causes with a deterministic scoring table, recommends at most two device-specific changes with exact One UI paths, trade-offs and how to undo them, and judges the outcome with a controlled before/after comparison. It never claims to have inspected the phone and avoids factory resets, calibration and optimizer apps.

name: samsung-battery-diagnostics
